name: Halos
description: Installs the halod agent (npm-distributed CLIs such as codex/gemini-cli need a root-owned node+npm in the base image: distro nodejs/npm or the nodejs.org install; the nvm-based node Feature is rejected by halod), applies the org's signed Halos release (pinned AI CLIs + managed settings), optionally locks egress to the gateway and registry.

registry.description: OCI repository holding releases, e.g. ghcr.io/acme/halos-releases

org.description: Org name; must equal the org in the signed release (halod requires org:)

pubkeyPem.description: ed25519 release public key, PKIX PEM contents (\n-escaped). Preferred; embedded inline, never downloaded.

pubkey.description: https URL of the public key PEM. Only accepted together with pubkeySha256, which is verified before use.

halodUrl.description: Download URL of the halod binary; {os} and {arch} are substituted

halodSha256.description: Required. sha256 (hex) of the halod binary, or 'amd64=<hex>,arm64=<hex>'. Verified before the binary is installed.

gatewayHost.description: Gateway hostname allowed through the firewall

firewall.description: Egress allowlist (gateway + registry only), default DROP for IPv4 and IPv6, started at container start via the feature entrypoint. Requires NET_ADMIN and NET_RAW.
